Typography guides recommend between forty-five and seventy-five characters per line for comfortable reading of running text. Lines that are much longer make it hard for the eye to find the start of the next line, while very short lines break the rhythm of reading. This paragraph has no maximum width, so on a wide desktop view each of its lines holds far more than eighty characters and is marked, while on a narrow phone view the same text wraps into short lines of fewer than forty-five characters.
